THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Order under Section 39(a) (1)

THE allotments specified in the Order No. 212 of 2016 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1983/43 dated 09.09.2016 are vested absolutely in the State and the possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the State under Paragraph (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue of powers vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39 (a) (inserted by Act, No.8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby divest only the allotment specified in the Schedule below.
K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.

My No.: 4-3/7/2015/HW/302. Land Acquiring Officer's No.: 4/1/1/32 - D Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secretariat,1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.11th September 2025.
